applicant.name: Prof. Daniel Berger
applicant.organisation: Institute for Public Health, regional planning group (university)

purpose: For resource planning we need to know how breast-cancer cases are distributed across regions as a share of all cases.
question: Of all patients with breast cancer, what percentage live in each region?
definitions: Breast cancer = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with C50.
Share = patients with breast cancer in the region / all patients with breast cancer x 100, one decimal.
Report per region: the share of breast-cancer patients, in %.
